source.table: Denk et al. (2018), Table 3 and footnote on minimum axis ratios

constraints.condition: Uniform-reflectivity reference ellipsoid inferred from low-phase lightcurve amplitude; lower limit, not exact dimensions.

assumptions: Select the lower-limit elongation, without treating it as a fitted full shape.
Reference radius interpreted as equal-volume scale for display only.
Arbitrary pole, spin sense and meridian; not an observed attitude.
approximation.qualification: Kiviuq may be a binary; its lightcurve does not establish a neck or separate components.

photometryCheck.interpretation: Zero-phase, equator-on, uniform-reflectivity projected-area model. This is a consistency check of the selected lower-limit ellipsoid, not a fit to the Cassini lightcurves.
